description: Ask Chat DLD a question in plain English and get its answer, exactly as dubaidiligence.com/chat gives it: Dubai Land Department records only, sourced, and a refusal rather than a guess when the records cannot answer. Pass back the `pending` value from the previous answer to continue a multi-step question such as a valuation.

pending.description: The `pending` object from the previous answer, when there was one.
